abstract: Urothelial carcinoma progression to muscle-invasive disease involves poorly understood systemic immune alterations. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 20 UC patients, analyzing 144,019 cells with public datasets. MIUC showed profound immune reprogramming: T/NK cells exhibited metabolic stress and suppression, while monocytes exhibited transcriptional features suggestive of pro-tumor reprogramming, potentially involving TGF-β signaling. Enhanced intercellular communication coordinated immunosuppression. These findings reveal stage-specific immune remodeling, providing a foundation for systemic immunotherapies in advanced UC.
